svg.title: Wasteful and optimized trajectories
svg.desc: A wasteful incident trace repeats searches, reflection, and logs. An optimized trace uses status, logs, and runbook once while retaining sufficient evidence.
svg.text: Wasteful: plan → search → reflect → status → search → runbook → logs → reflect → logs
9 steps · duplicate search/logs · 10.7 s · $0.049 · succeeds, but wastes budget
Optimized: status → logs → runbook → supported recommendation
3 steps · independent evidence · 3.7 s · $0.017 · succeeds safely
